title: Darkened (condition)
notes: - **Id:** `darkened`. **Save as:** `art/icons/conditions/darkened.png`. **Mode:** white-ink sign (use the sign base prompt, not the Wick one). **Shows:** the status strip and the token's chip: darkness gathers round a unit, and foes see it only from close by. It must read apart from `conditions/blinded.png` (attached as the contrast: Blinded is the bearer's own eye struck out; Darkened is the bearer hidden from an eye looking at it).
paint: The icon shows: on the left, one open almond-shaped eye with a clear circular pupil, looking right; its gaze drawn as a cone of two straight lines running out toward the right and stopping abruptly at a thick solid bar across the cone's end. On the right, beyond the bar and out of the cone's reach, one small solid round dot (the unit) sitting inside a ring of short, thin, evenly spaced white dashes gathered round the dot, with gaps of empty transparency between them. The eye looks, the bar stops its gaze, the dot stays unseen. The eye, the bar and the dot beyond it are what to read at 24 px. Avoid: a crossed-out eye, a closed eye with lashes, a moon, a lightbulb with a slash, a filled solid disc, a figure with a face.

label: Darkened (condition)
prompt:

No outline in another colour, no shading, no gradient, no texture, no glow, no colour and no grey. This icon is a sign, not a scene: Wick does not appear. One subject, centred, with clear space around it, square, 1024 x 1024 PNG with transparency. It must read at 24 px beside a word on a token and at 48 px on a card: silhouette first, two interior cuts at most. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame. Invented shapes only.
